lines.text: Many learners say: I am a pan of this singer.
Better: I am a fan of this singer.
Fan! I am a fan of this singer.

data.wrong: I am a pan of this singer.
data.right: I am a fan of this singer.

quiz.stem: I am a ___ of this singer.

native.tip: 한국어에는 f 소리가 없어서 fan을 pan처럼 말하기 쉬워요. 팬은 fan! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “I am a fan of this singer.”
native.caption: “I am a pan of this singer”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어에는 f 소리가 없어서 fan을 pan으로 쓰기 쉬워요. pan은 프라이팬이고, 좋아하는 팬은 fan이에요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “I am a fan of this singer.” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: A pan is for cooking. A fan loves a singer. Say “I am a fan of this singer.”
en.caption: Do you say “I am a pan of this singer” in English? 😅 A pan is for cooking, and a fan loves a singer! “I am a fan of this singer” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
